product_metadata.title: Star Cutouts, George Clooney Life-Size Cardboard Cutout Standee
description: 71 x 23 inches. Bring the Hollywood heartthrob right into your home with this eco-friendly George Clooney life-size cardboard cutout standee! Made with high-quality recycled cardboard and printed with latex ink for stunning HD results, this cutout is digitally die cut for a perfect finish. Plus, our print-on-demand process ensures that your Clooney standee arrives in pristine condition. Perfect for movie nights, parties, or just adding a touch of glamour to your space, this cardboard cutout will have you feeling like you're on the red carpet with George himself. Get your hands on this must-have piece of Hollywood memorabilia today! All cardboard cutouts come folded and have an easel attached to the back to be self-standing. Items are printed and produced to order. Printing and processing takes up to 5 business days plus shipping time.
